- **Albums opens fast, however many you have (FL-1297):** the Albums page no longer counts every photo in every album each time it opens, and it draws only the albums near the screen. A library of thousands of albums and hundreds of thousands of photos shows its full structure straight away and stays smooth while you scroll.
- **Lock and Unlock in the album menus (FL-1296):** right-click an album or open its menu to lock or unlock it, on the Albums page and in the sidebar, without going through album options. Locking an album works as it always has: your photos in it move to Locked, and anything you add later is locked too.
- **Merge one album into another (FL-1298):** choose Merge with… on any album you own. The album with the most photos keeps its name and icon, every photo and link from both ends up in it, and photos in both are counted once. No photos leave your library, and you can undo a merge afterwards. If an album is shared, Frameleaf tells you who gains or loses access before you agree.
- **Heal lost photo dates (FL-1299):** some photos lose their capture date and show the day they were imported instead. When the rest of an album says when they were taken, Magic Albums offers a date from around them. Nothing changes until you approve it, and healed dates are marked as estimated in the photo's details.
- **Tidy your albums with Magic Albums (FL-1300):** Frameleaf reads your album names, dates and locations and suggests one tidy structure: names like “Trips - 2016 - Disney” become nested collections, exact duplicates merge, days in a row become one album, and days away from home become one trip under Trips. A banner on Albums opens a review where you can adjust everything before you apply it, and nothing changes until you do. Albums you leave out stay exactly as they are, no photos leave your library, and you can undo the whole cleanup for 30 days. If an iCloud sync runs between removing an iCloud album and undoing it, the album comes back but stays unlinked from iCloud. The banner only appears when there is plenty to tidy, and once you are done it lives in Library Care.
- **Manager:** no changes in this release; its version moves with the server.
